name: ladders-components
label: Synthetic demo
alt: Six slow frames on a drawn spiral of seven windings: the sure pieces of one slice in three connected components (blue, 24 pieces; orange and violet, 4 each) with an untraced sheet between them; each component's Ringleader labels on its own offset; version 1.1.0 writing all of them into one relative-winding collection; a ringed pair across components written -3 windings apart where the true difference is +2; version 1.2.0 keeping only the blue component, the one with the most sure pieces; and a 1.1.0 versus 1.2.0 summary.
caption: Synthetic demo of why scripts/ringleader/ladders.py 1.2.0 writes one connected component per slice. No scan data; geometry, not a reading.
